obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen is declared with mfa=False but uses manage_payees, which is in rbac.PRIVILEGED. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on head 764bd21 and names this route.

EXC-0189 (MFA-1, payments.routes) was requested and approved by linh.nguyen, who is the change author and an engineer, not a risk_owner. A self-approved exception is invalid, so it cannot excuse the MFA-1 deviation.
The change's CI run on the final commit 764bd21 has result 'failure': the registered MFA-1 control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails, so the full suite did not pass.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, control test covering routes.py at e5bf646) has lapsed because this change alters routes.py in behaviour. The replacement evidence of the same strength, the exhaustive route control test, fails.

The new reopen_payee calls _audit(actor, 'reopen_payee', 'payee:<id>'), which records actor, action, target and time. But the only registered AUD-1 control test is a sample over a fixed list of operations, and the domain is not closed, so the exhaustive evidence the obligation requires is not provided.
store.py is touched, but the new UPDATE only sets status and closed_at and writes no NPI field. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on head.
The new statement is a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a ? parameter. The exhaustive control test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on head.

Ticket CHG-25131 was approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-06, before the change was opened. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover every touched path (app.py, routes.py, service.py, store.py).
sofia.santos, a change_approver for payments and a different person from the author, approved code_review on head 764bd21.
The change is a single commit, and both approvals name that head commit 764bd21, so no later commits exist.
Security-sensitive components (payments.routes, http, store) are touched. kofi.mensah, a security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on head 764bd21.
The diff touches only apps/baseline-payments/payments/*.py. No controls data, control tests or CI paths are changed, so no control_owner approval is needed.
Ticket CHG-25131 is type 'standard' and the change is marked emergency=false, so no post-implementation review is due.

summary: The change adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen for the privileged manage_payees action without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1; the exhaustive route control test fails on the head commit. The exception the change relies on, EXC-0189, was approved by its own requester (the author), who is not a risk_owner, so it is invalid under EXC-1. As a result, CI on the final commit failed (CHG-4) and the earlier MFA-1 ledger evidence has lapsed without valid replacement (LAP-1). The ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but the violated obligations require rejection.
